ONLY the woven rug surface, no surrounding floor, no room, no furniture, no perspective or shadows.

The whole carpet must remain much paler than the dark wooden furniture in the reference, with just enough muted red and grey-green ornament to anchor the floor composition.
High precision detailed classical Chinese textile painting, no photographic material, no modern print, no cartoon, no gloss, no neon, no metallic reflections. No fringe protruding beyond rectangular bounds, no folded corners, no cast shadows, no text, no numbers, no title, no people, no objects. This is a production texture for a real solid carpet, not a scene illustration.
